description:
Whether you're just starting out or a seasoned pro still searching for success, this channel is built to guide you. With 28 years of experience across HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and construction, I’ve seen why some careers thrive while others stall—and I’m here to help you avoid the pitfalls.

If you’re ready to:
- Avoid rookie mistakes that slow your progress.
- Learn how attitude can make or break your career.
- Understand why customer service is the key to HVAC success.
- Transform your team into future leaders as a business owner.

Then you're in the right place. I’ll share the lessons I learned the hard way, saving you time, money, and headaches. Subscribe and start building the career you deserve.
